title: Connection test?- A response and my own experience
content: Ok I've been going to mall world for years now and no one I talked to understood it. Stumbled across this thread and I'm blown away, this will be very unorganized and I apologize for that. I'll start with my main point then add the backstory. Awhile ago someone on here proposed the idea of meeting people in the dream and confirming it. Maybe a simpler way to do it would be with a hand gesture like making an "L" and holding it to your forehead, if you remember and do it in a mall world dream make a post with everything you can remember of the dream like specific events or shops you saw and if you're someone who sees another person holding an L on their forehead do the same. Then just compare notes. Now as for myself, I spent years lost on one side of mall world but have been to the abandoned stairwell-area, the bathroom and showers(always hostile, being chased or fighting. It reminds me of the old roman bathhouses), the underground pipe area, the ice ring and stadium, "highway"?, suburb area, school world, beach, lots of places(has anyone seen that long tunnel thing? It's like a giant ditch that runs for miles, along the way there's a suburb, swamp/forest area,train tracks..). I've also been able to lucid dream extremely well most of my life to a level most people don't understand or believe. Like I can break the dream in a lot of cases. I've flown out into space to try and find the boundaries, a castle appeared to tempt me but I kept going and reached an office area, like cubicles and stuff. I won't get into it but the people there felt like aliens and didn't want me there, they basically tricked me into sleeping and sent me back where I dreamed normally for a bit until I woke up. But yea, I'm rambling, it's just crazy to find other people who've had dreams like this. There's so much I want to get into like has anyone else snuck into secret areas? How often do you see animals and what kind? I bet you see more large and exotic animals as opposed to birds and cats. Anyway If you ever see someone running at full speed on all fours or flying/floating to get on the roof or generally shape shifting and using weird powers in mall world there's a good chance it's me. That's usually what I'm doing haha sweet dreams everyone
